summary: Project is shifting toward a multi-page, professional crypto-token website experience (Interlink-ID-inspired theme) while preserving existing core sections and functionality, with a unified real-time analytics hub that combines Market Intelligence + AI Sentiment, passcode-gated signal access, and improved section theming/UX consistency across the site.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication provider
existing_features.description: Provides a React context (InternetIdentityProvider) that initializes DFINITY AuthClient, loads/persists identity, supports login/logout, and exposes status flags for UI logic.

existing_features.title: ICP canister actor creation and caching per identity
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous or authenticated backend actor depending on Internet Identity state, caches it via React Query, and initializes backend access control using a secret parameter from the URL hash/session.

existing_features.title: Backend role-based access control (admin/user/guest) with admin bootstrap token
existing_features.description: Implements AccessControl with roles (#admin/#user/#guest), admin-only role assignment, permission checks, and a bootstrap flow where the first caller providing the correct env token becomes admin; others become users.

existing_features.title: Market Intelligence access gating (grant/revoke/check)
existing_features.description: Backend stores per-principal access grants for Market Intel. Authenticated users can grant or revoke access by providing the configured password; access checks gate protected endpoints and the frontend unlock flow.

existing_features.title: Real-time market data fetching from external APIs (crypto + forex) with retries/timeouts
existing_features.description: Frontend fetches crypto market data via CoinGecko and forex rates via exchangerate.host with AbortController timeouts, retry logic, and exponential backoff; auto-refresh via React Query intervals.

existing_features.title: Standard trading signal generation with advanced technical indicators
existing_features.description: Generates RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, Moving Average, Fair Value Gap, and Order Blocks signals; computes a weighted overall signal and a derived historical accuracy score for display.

existing_features.title: Binary trading signal generation (WIN/LOSS) with probability and confidence
existing_features.description: Computes a binary prediction (WIN/LOSS) with confidence and winProbability, influenced by fetched price trend/volatility and seeded randomness; displayed in a dedicated Binary Trading UI mode.

existing_features.title: Acquisition Portal with presale/airdrop countdown locks and form submission
existing_features.description: Provides separate presale and airdrop registration forms with date-based countdown timers, progress visualization, validation, backend submission via actor.submitForm, and WhatsApp redirection for confirmation.

existing_features.title: Backend form submission storage and management
existing_features.description: Backend stores FormSubmission records with timestamps and submittedBy principal; supports create, read (own/admin), update/delete (own/admin), admin listing/filtering by type/country, and admin submission counts plus mass delete.

existing_features.title: Backend timer endpoints for presale/airdrop plus admin-controlled timer state
existing_features.description: Exposes public remaining-time queries for presale/airdrop end times and admin-only APIs to toggle/update/delete timer states stored in a timers map.

existing_features.title: Unified Analytics Platform page (MarketIntelPage) with passcode unlock/lock UI
existing_features.description: Frontend page that verifies access via backend, provides passcode unlock/lock flows (including revoke confirmation dialog), asset/timeframe selectors, refresh controls, loading/error states, and indicator/signal visualizations.

existing_features.title: Live price dashboard with auto-refresh and heat map
existing_features.description: Displays a live-updating list of assets with simulated price/24h change updates and a heat-map style summary grid.

existing_features.title: Advanced analytics dashboard (portfolio/risk/correlation/performance tabs)
existing_features.description: Provides a multi-panel analytics UI with portfolio value, volatility, Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, correlation matrix progress bars, and time-window performance tabs (currently static sample data).

existing_features.title: Tokenomics visualization and breakdown
existing_features.description: Interactive pie chart (recharts) showing token allocation percentages, total supply display, hover-highlighted allocation cards, and explanatory sections for deflationary model and utility.

existing_features.title: Whitepaper page with chapter navigation and scroll-based active section tracking
existing_features.description: Renders structured whitepaper content with a sticky chapter sidebar, scroll-to-section navigation, and IntersectionObserver logic to highlight the active chapter and animate section visibility.

existing_features.title: Community governance and voting pages (UI)
existing_features.description: Governance explainer page plus a community voting UI with proposals, vote tallies, quorum badges, and client-side vote tracking with toasts (simulated “on-chain” recording in UI messaging).

existing_features.title: Contact page with mailto-based messaging and direct channel links
existing_features.description: Implements a validated contact form that opens the user’s email client via a mailto link and provides Telegram/WhatsApp direct links, with UX feedback via toasts.

existing_features.title: Site-wide navigation, layout, theme, and notifications
existing_features.description: Provides root layout with next-themes ThemeProvider, footer, scrollable bottom navigation (TanStack Router navigation), and global toaster notifications.

existing_features.title: Backend HTTP outcall helper (GET/POST) with transform
existing_features.description: Provides reusable functions for canister HTTP requests with cycle budgeting, user-agent/idempotency headers, and a transform function that strips response headers.

existing_features.title: Backend blob storage operations via Caffeine storage mixin
existing_features.description: Includes functions to update authorized gateway principals from a cashier canister, check blob liveness, list/prune dead blobs with authorization checks, trigger GC, and refill cashier/top-up via cycles.

existing_features.title: Backend generic content record stores with admin CRUD and public reads
existing_features.description: Implements per-type content stores (testimonials/insights/faq/governance/ecosystem/whitepaper/roadmap/about/community/security/contact) with admin create/update/delete/mass-populate/clear and public getRecords read access.

existing_features.title: Backend user profile management
existing_features.description: Authenticated users can save and query their own UserProfile; admins can query arbitrary profiles; includes access checks for privacy.

architectural_notes: Frontend is a SPA using TanStack Router for routing and TanStack React Query for server/cache state management; toasts via sonner; UI styled with TailwindCSS and shadcn/ui components.
Internet Identity integration is encapsulated in a React context provider; identity persistence is handled via AuthClient local storage.
Backend is a Motoko actor using an in-memory state model with mo:core Map structures; permissions enforced via a custom AccessControl module (admin/user/guest).
Motoko uses a mixin pattern (include MixinAuthorization, include blob-storage/Mixin) to compose features into the main canister.
Admin bootstrap uses an environment variable (CAFFEINE_ADMIN_TOKEN) combined with a user-provided secret; first matching caller becomes admin, subsequent principals become users.

Market intelligence “live” analytics are computed client-side; the backend mainly provides access gating and also includes a separate admin-only MarketIntelligence store that is not used by the live UI.
ICP management-style HTTP outcall helper exists (GET/POST + transform) with fixed cycle budgeting; response headers are stripped in transform.
A blob-storage subsystem exists for gateway authorization and dead-blob pruning, plus a cashier refill/top-up flow using cycles.

Access gating requirement: Market Intelligence signal generation/display must be blocked unless passcode B2420075112009P is verified; AI Sentiment panel remains publicly visible within the same Analytics hub.
known_issues: Hard-coded secrets: market intel password is embedded in backend (marketIntelPassword) and referenced in frontend copy; admin token is passed via URL hash parameter (though cleared) and used to initialize access control.
Most backend state is not declared as stable and there are no preupgrade/postupgrade hooks shown; data (submissions, access grants, records, etc.) may be lost on canister upgrade.
Storage module environment variable name appears misspelled: "CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL" (triple “F”), which is easy to misconfigure.
Storage.refillCashier uses Nat.sub(currentBalance, reservedCycles) without guarding when reservedCycles > currentBalance; can trap on low-cycle canisters.
Frontend has nested QueryClientProviders (one in main.tsx and another in App.tsx), creating redundant React Query clients/caches and potential confusion.
Real-time market data relies on public external APIs without API keys; CoinGecko can rate-limit/timeout. Forex 24h change/volume is partially simulated with randomness (not real market data).
Indicator/signal generation intentionally uses randomness/seeded math; results are not fully deterministic and may change frequently (seed uses Date.now slicing).
Backend constant maxSubmissions is defined but not enforced; submissions can grow unbounded until memory limits.
Role initialization requires calling _initializeAccessControlWithSecret before other role-checked calls; direct callers who skip initialization can hit traps like "User is not registered".
Market Intel lock/unlock behavior and passcode gating are still unreliable; signals can appear without proper unlock or fail to lock again.
Theme redesign is inconsistently applied across sections; some pages/components remain with old styling, causing readability/visibility issues.
Voting section content needs to be replaced with a "coming soon" placeholder per latest requirement.
